evaluation_scope: Same 1000 test IDs for all methods; exact soft CE/KL only on common valid labels. Fixed-k/oracle exact CE is marked infinite when support is incompatible. Expected metrics correspond to sampling k; argmax metrics correspond to deterministic deployment.

validation_selected_fixed_k.criterion: highest mean validation answer F1; smallest k tie

query_specificity.interpretation: Variation alone is insufficient; aligned CE below shuffled CE checks whether variation is query-specific rather than noise.
